description: "Summon three patches of skeletal claws from the ground in front of you. Enemies in the first area are snared by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, immobilized in the second area for |cffffff4|r seconds, and stunned in the final area for |cffffff3|r seconds.\n\nEach patch applies Minor Maim to enemies hit for |cffffff10|r seconds, reducing their damage done by |cffffff5|r%."
